## Type of change

* [ ] Correction of a factual error
* [ ] Improvement to an existing page
* [ ] New pattern page (used `templates/pattern-template.md`)
* [ ] New or updated case study
* [ ] Tooling, workflow, or repository housekeeping

## Checklist

* [ ] The tone is neutral. No pattern is presented as the best choice for everyone.
* [ ] Pros and cons are honest and describe real trade offs.
* [ ] Claims about companies or products cite a source, and anything uncertain is marked as uncertain.
* [ ] I wrote the text myself and did not copy it from another source.
* [ ] Mermaid diagrams use standard syntax and render on GitHub.
* [ ] Relative links work.
* [ ] If I changed a diagram that also has a file in `assets/diagrams/`, I re rendered it.
* [ ] `npx markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` passes locally.
